title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the rate of precession, omega_p = 3k/(2m omega_0).

title: Effective Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and write the effective potential U(r) including all relevant terms.

title: Taylor Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Taylor expansion around r_0 and retain the appropriate terms.

title: Radial Oscillation Frequency
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the angular frequency of small oscillations, omega_r, correctly.

title: Direction of Precession
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention that the direction of precession is opposite to that of revolution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the effective potential.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms are consistent in units throughout the derivation.
